in runRound · internal/agent/
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   35 // runRound sends one request and runs the calls it asks for. It returns
   36 // ErrRoundLimit when the session has spent its rounds, and the caller
   37 // decides whether to offer more.
   38 func (l *Loop) runRound(ctx context.Context) error {
   39     if l.rounds >= l.maxRounds {
   40         return ErrRoundLimit
   41     }
   42     l.rounds++
   43     resp, err := l.provider.Send(ctx, l.request())
   44     if err != nil {
   45         return fmt.Errorf("round %d: %w", l.rounds, err)
   46     }
   47     for _, call := range resp.Calls {
   48         if err := l.run(ctx, call); err != nil {
   49             return err
   50         }
   51     }
   52     return nil
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
